segments.ja462:1.1: Jānanto no mahārāja, tava sīlaṃ janādhipo;
segments.ja462:1.3: Ime kumāre pūjento, na taṃ kenaci maññatha.
segments.ja462:2.1: Tiṭṭhante no mahārāje, adu [ādu (sī. pī.), ādū (syā.)] deve divaṅgate;
segments.ja462:4.1: Na rājaputta usūyāmi [rājaputta nussuyyāmi (ka.)], samaṇānaṃ mahesinaṃ;
segments.ja462:4.3: Sakkaccaṃ te namassāmi, pāde vandāmi tādinaṃ.
segments.ja462:5.3: Samaṇā manusāsanti [samanusāsanti (sī. syā. pī.)], isī dhammaguṇe ratā.
segments.ja462:6.3: Na kiñci atimaññāmi, dhamme me nirato mano.
segments.ja462:8.1: Mahāmattā ca me atthi, mantino paricārakā;
segments.ja462:9.3: Tesu me vihitā rakkhā, evaṃ jānāhuposatha.
segments.ja462:10.1: Dhammena kira ñātīnaṃ, rajjaṃ kārehi saṃvara;
segments.ja462:10.3: Medhāvī paṇḍito cāsi [cāpi (sī. pī.)], athopi ñātinaṃ hito.
